connector.name: Angel Numbers MCP Server by RoxyAPI
connector.registryDescription: Angel number meanings and repeating sequences like 111, 222, 333 for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at roxyapi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.roxyapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
